angebot.text: Uncle Alwin is off on a grand carrot cruise — and instead of selling, he presses a giant key into Gooby's paw. With a note: “The store likes you. Water the till twice a week.”
angebot.frage: Will you take over the little corner store?
angebot.zu_wenig: Not enough coins yet — the key costs {preis}. It waits patiently.

intro.zeile1: Uncle Alwin ran the little corner store for 40 years — today he hangs up his apron and leaves on a grand carrot cruise.
intro.zeile2: He presses a key into Gooby's paw that's bigger than his head. With a note: “The store likes you. Water the till twice a week.”
intro.zeile3: The door says “Goo!” on the way in and “Bye…” on the way out. From now on it's up to you: shelf by shelf, carrot by carrot, beep by beep.

laden.erst_einraeumen: Stock a shelf first — customers need something to grab!
laden.regal_voll: That slot is already full to the top.
laden.lager_leer: The storage is empty — get restock!

nachschub.hinweis: The wholesale market delivers to the store door — you pay wholesale, you sell at the suggested price.
nachschub.zu_teuer: Not quite enough coins for that.

grossmarkt.hinweis: Behind REHWEI the traders’ ramp opens: buy at 60 % of the suggested price. The car really drives — order, wait, unload.
grossmarkt.korb_leer: Pack some crates first — tap “+” on an item.
grossmarkt.kofferraum_voll: The trunk won’t fit any more!
grossmarkt.zu_teuer: Not quite enough coins for that.
grossmarkt.schon_unterwegs: The car is already on the road — unload first, then order again.
grossmarkt.ausgeladen: {kisten} crates head into storage — clonk, clonk, clonk!
grossmarkt.bestellt_toast: Trunk lid shut — the car rolls off to the ramp!
grossmarkt.lieferwagen_gate: From shop level {ziel} — your shop: level {level} ({name})
grossmarkt.lieferwagen_gesperrt: The company van arrives at shop level {ziel} — keep those market days coming!

uebergabe.zeile1: Two honks outside: Uncle Alwin pulls up in the freshly painted box van — brand teal, with the apostrophe ears wobbling in the logo on its side.
uebergabe.zeile2: “Your auntie hauled her very first carrot load in this van. Now it belongs to YOUR shop — the back fits 48 crates, I counted twice.”
uebergabe.zeile3: He presses the car key into Gooby’s paw and dabs one eye when he thinks no one’s looking. “Drive safely. And honk twice at the ramp — Mrs. Rehwald always loves that.”

tagesangebot.titel: Pick the deal of the day
tagesangebot.hinweis: One group per day: −15 % off the price — and far more paws reach for it. Gooby doodles the sign himself.
tagesangebot.gewaehlt: Deal of the day set: {name} — the sign is up!
tagesangebot.schon_gewaehlt: Today’s deal is already picked — try again tomorrow!

kuehl.voll: Not enough cool space — a cooling module holds {je} chilled items.
kuehl.modul_gekauft: A cooling module hums along now — +{je} cool slots.
kuehl.modul_zu_teuer: Not quite enough coins for that.

abschluss.untertitel: Lights out, the door whispers “Bye…” — time to count.
abschluss.verpasst: {anzahl}× someone found an empty shelf — that sold out fast!
